warnings.label: North Sea coast from Staithes to Whitby including tidal River Esk
warnings.description: North Sea coast from Staithes to Whitby including tidal River Esk
warnings.message:
High tides, strong winds and large waves tomorrow morning may lead to flooding. 

Flooding is possible from 03:30 to 07:00 on Monday 28/09/2026. 

Locations most affected will be coastal roads and footpaths along the North Sea coast from Staithes to Whitby, including Sandsend and the tidal River Esk. 

We are closely monitoring the situation and closing locks and flood gates. 

Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water . 

This message will be updated by 6:15AM on 28 September 2026 or as the situation changes.

warnings.label: Somerset coast at Porlock Weir
warnings.message:
High tides today may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 18:00 to 20:00 on 27/09/2026. 
High tides this evening may lead to flooding.  

Flooding is forecast to affect locations at Porlock Bay, with low lying land and roads expected to be most affected, particularly around the coastline between Gore Point and Hurlstone Point including Porlock Weir. The highest tide is at 19:15 on Sunday 27/09/2026 with a peak height of 6.19m and a F5 westerly wind. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water . 
This message will be updated by 9:00AM on 28 September 2026 or as the situation changes.

warnings.label: Northumberland coast
warnings.message:
There is no longer a threat of flooding, though standing water and debris may still remain. 
The previous tide of concern has now passed,  the weather is more settled and no flooding is expected.   
We will continue to monitor the situation and will issue further alerts or warnings if necessary.   
Continue to take care on waterside roads and footpaths and don't put yourself in unnecessary danger. Never drive through flood water,  just 30cm of fast flowing water is enough to move your car.

warnings.label: The north Norfolk coast from Old Hunstanton, to and including Cley
warnings.description: The north Norfolk coast from Old Hunstanton, to and including Cley
warnings.message: High tides tomorrow may lead to flooding. Flooding is possible between 6:45am and 8:45am tomorrow, Monday 28 September. We expect to see water on roads and paths to beaches and on the quays in Brancaster, Burnham Overy, Holkham, Wells and Blakeney. The detailed forecast is for a peak level at Wells of 3.65mAODN at 7:45am, on Monday 28 September, which is 0.26m above tide tables, Wind Force 3, Northerly. Tides are expected to be higher than usual, due to the forecast weather conditions during spring tides. We are closely monitoring the situation. Avoid coastal roads, which may be flooded. This message will be updated by 10:00PM on 28 September 2026 or as the situation changes.

warnings.label: Tidal areas of Shoreham Harbour
warnings.message:
High tides on Monday may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible for 1 hour either side of Monday afternoon's tide at 13:00 on 28/09/2026.. 
The weather increases tide table values by 0.5 m. Total forecast tide is 6.90 metres Chart Datum (3.63 mAOD) at Shoreham. Light North Easterly Force 3 wind. The tide will come close to the top of walls and slipways in Shoreham Town. Minor impact flooding will affect Sussex Yacht Club. Riverbank houseboats will be raised higher than normal, making access to them temporarily more difficult. Tuesday's tide at 01:15 29/09/2026 is forecast to be 16 cm lower (3.47 mAOD).  Flood impacts should reduce‚ but could return on Tuesday afternoon's tide at 13:30 29/09/2026. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid beaches and coastal promenades, which may be flooded . 
This message will be updated by 6:00PM on 28 September 2026 or as the situation changes.
